currentArchitecture.deployment: static vendor-neutral build remains production baseline; Docker Compose EU-VPS stack is implemented as an unverified deployment preview
currentArchitecture.backend: Fastify TypeScript API implementation preview; not deployed or enabled in the local UI
currentArchitecture.database: Postgres 17 schema, default-deny RLS and migrator/app-role separation implemented; no production database provisioned
currentArchitecture.authentication: Magic-link and hashed-cookie session routes implemented and contract-tested; production SMTP and deployment verification remain open
currentArchitecture.sensorGateway: read-only CSV/JSON file connector validation core; no live sensor or actuator connection
currentArchitecture.persistence: multi-run RunRepository with RunPackage v6 in IndexedDB; typed resilient storage, protected read-only mode, staged restore, workspace-backup-v2, encrypted rotating checkpoint vault, encrypted media store and local sync outbox
currentArchitecture.telemetry: local privacy-preserving diagnostics plus opt-in server-side OpenTelemetry traces and metrics; collector deployment config validates, but production diagnostics are not yet deployed or verified

experienceLens.invariant: The lens changes information density and explanation only, never source data, calculations, limits, or safety gates.

capabilities.evidence: React UI, canonical workbook snapshot, knowledge base, exports, tests and CI exist in this repository.
RunPackage schema v6, v1-v6 migration, resilient multi-run IndexedDB, staging restore, SHA-256 JSON and workspace-backup-v2, CSV/XLSX/PDF exports and recovery tests are implemented.

Immutable configuration snapshots, applyRunCommand, zones, plants, ScientificValue lineage, DomainEvent envelopes, operations state machines, devices/calibrations, revisions, supersession and append-only audit events are implemented.

Simulation-to-Live cloning, confirmed seed-planted UTC anchor, exact 24-hour live day, independent view day, clock rollback blocking, audited anchor correction and completion commands are implemented and unit-tested.

ukd-ai-exchange/1 redacts prohibited data; ukd-ai-proposal/1 uses quarantine, schema/base-hash/safety validation, correction requests and individually audited accept/reject commands. No model is called by the local UI.

AES-GCM workspace checkpoints, SHA-256 readback, 20/30/12 rotation, completion retention, File System Access folder writes, download fallback, recovery-kit import and weekly isolated validation are implemented. A multi-day real-browser restore drill remains a Stable gate.
Users can create and switch isolated local runs through the RunRepository without overwriting historical snapshots.
Manual measured values are recorded separately from targets; canonical persistent alerts, acknowledgements and event history are implemented.

The nutrient route and mix recorder resolve each plant from confirmed emergence, nutrient-uptake, root-zone and flowering events. Missing events fail closed; calendar age is display-only and a mixed bloom state blocks the unspecific global batch recorder. Plant-targeted dose curves beyond the v11.5 eligibility map remain a follow-up editor depth gate.
Web App Manifest and production service worker cache the application shell and canonical read-only datasets.
SHA-256-verified backup/restore plus CSV, XLSX, PDF and print outputs are available without a backend; corruption and v2 migration are tested.

The read-only provider contract and trust engine cover freshness, calibration, plausibility and conflicts. Live ingestion is not implemented; the current UI only captures manual pH/EC calibration and PPFD-map records.
A local user-triggered diagnostic bundle exports app/storage/schema health and counts without measurements, notes, legal profiles or credentials.

capabilities.trigger: A named device protocol, trust boundary, offline behavior and calibration model are approved.
Plant identity deep links, camera permission UX, offline QR decoding, duplicate-ID prevention and manual fallback pass threat-model and accessibility review. QR is the cross-platform baseline.
Runtime capability negotiation proves supported Web NFC or a separately reviewed native shell. NFC must never be the only route to a plant record.

A licensed, representative cannabis dataset, external validation, calibrated uncertainty, out-of-distribution rejection, device benchmarks and a human-confirmation workflow are approved. Model brand, size or headline accuracy alone is insufficient.
On-device speech availability is detected at runtime and a touch/keyboard fallback remains complete. Parsed commands require visible confirmation before applyRunCommand.

A named protocol and device are approved with identity, units, calibration, freshness, plausibility, deduplication, offline replay and conflict tests. Browser/platform limitations require capability negotiation.
No actuator command path is authorized. A future proposal requires a separate hazard analysis, manual override, fail-safe state, watchdog, interlock, commissioning and liability review.
A low-luminance theme passes WCAG 2.2 AA, real grow-room usability and device checks. It may reduce glare but must not be labelled as preserving a plant dark cycle or as a safe green-light source.
Explicit field-level redaction, consent, provenance, moderation, deletion, abuse prevention and legal/privacy review exist. Public social feeds are outside the local-first Stable baseline.

capabilities.evidence: IPM, Incident/Recovery, generic Equipment/Maintenance and personal product inventory have command-based UI slices with state transition, audit and timeline records. Rich editor depth and human-factors validation remain release gates.
Reservoir/Lung Room, Energy, Post-Harvest and Mix Application UI paths exist and use the common command gateway; full checkpoint editors and stable E2E matrix remain open.
Browser images are oriented, re-encoded to WebP, EXIF-stripped, hashed and AES-GCM encrypted. Recovery kit and manifested backup are implemented; cross-device restore drills remain open.

Setup profiles and run templates are versioned outside active immutable snapshots. Creating from a template produces a new run identity; workspace-backup-v2 includes the real workspace, all runs and encrypted media in one validated activation transaction.

Read-only CSV/JSON probe-map-validate-preview-commit workflow blocks missing identity/unit/time, mismatches and duplicates; committed readings remain unverified and enter through applyRunCommand with audit and timeline. A larger fuzz corpus remains open.

Provider-neutral server interface and OpenAI Responses adapter use store:false, Structured Outputs, pseudonymous safety identifier and grounding enforcement. Context retrieval, UI, live credentials and full evals remain disabled/open.

capabilities.trigger: Fastify/Postgres/Magic-Link/Sync code and Docker Compose are present, but production SMTP, media object flow, two-device integration tests, migration deployment and EU-VPS restore proof remain mandatory before activation.
Browser-side PDF/XLSX export fails documented fidelity or performance criteria.
SSR, authenticated server features, dynamic route handlers, database access or server-side jobs provide measured product value.
